_about: The exam-competency framework of Ruukkilabra (teacher's brief 2026-10-28, NOTES.md §9). `competencies`: the six competencies a module develops, in this order everywhere; their names are in lang/<lang>.json "competency". `criteria`: the shared rubric criteria of the Sovella itsenäisesti tasks, key -> competency; their texts are in lang/<lang>.json "criteria", so a task names a key instead of repeating the text and a translation translates it once. scripts/practice.py validates every task against this file; scripts/coverage.py reports where each competency is taught and practised.

competencies.concept: conceptual understanding: recognise phenomena, explain principles and relationships, correct misconceptions
competencies.math: mathematical problem-solving: formulate and manipulate equations, units, precision, reasonableness
competencies.graph: graphical and numerical analysis: build a graph from data, axes and units, points, choose a fit, read quantities, model validity, interpolate and extrapolate, scatter
competencies.experiment: experimental reasoning: design, variables and controls, methods, systematic and random errors, reliability, shortcomings of a report
competencies.communication: scientific communication: clear explanations, justified assumptions and models, complete solutions, interpreted results
competencies.transfer: independent transfer: unfamiliar context, relevant information, choose the model and strategy without being told the formula
